# COMB-A build report

Status: implementation and packed artifacts are ready for review, but the required acceptance gate is NOT fully passing. A31 was left out under the file rules. The combined source gzip budget and the strict no-worse p95 performance comparison remain failed. No independent reviewers or agents were started.

## Final verification

- Passing: steps-test, nova-test, depth-test, layout-test, explore-test, finds-test, motion-test, hammer-test, whirl2-test, frame-cost-test, frame-performance-test, frame-render-test, and the new shared-close tests.
- The last source budget result is 171.05 KB / 160 KB source; map 287.30 KB / 320 KB and joined 507.74 KB / 540 KB packed. The 160 KB source limit was kept; it was not raised. Packed-file gzip budgets still pass.
- Native headless Edge measurements cover both packed pages at 1440x900, 1280x720, 1024x600, 820x1180, 412x730, 390x844, 360x640, and 844x390. Primary title, kicker, stop-name, subtitle and legend text boxes have no measured overlaps or off-screen boxes. All six cards fit without internal scrolling.
- The native card/tail check passes at all eight sizes. Its worst measured rim error is 0.014 px in the retained runs.
- Native behaviour checks cover camera-ready hammer entry, sheet-owned keys, early closing, popup focus return, card focus handoff, reduced-motion switching, and end-state inert controls. The shared score test covers 54 sheet exits and three mid-close reversals.
- WHIRL2's original blast/remnant hash remains unchanged. Its 261 trail/sea comparisons and 45 blast/remnant comparisons pass. The trail-run and sea-placement assertions in nova-test were kept.
- These are self-checks, not a real-phone review or an independent design verdict.

## Reference continuity and limits

The approved sheet-map.jpg and sheet-cards-footer.jpg, BRIEF.md, AUDIT-R2.md, the supplied COMB-A findings, existing source, and GLIDE-BUILD.md informed the work. The comparison kept the two-island chart, terrain density, Norse drawings, branded shield/card pairs, real logos, Lennard's white band and orange field, the footer name, and the original nova score.

Concrete acceptance criteria were: readable and separated labels; the same objects entering and reversing to their anchors; no hidden controls in Tab order; 44 px touch padding; no card scroll boxes; restrained role-based colour; visible find counting; and preserved trail, sea and glide behaviour. The overview on a landscape phone deliberately places the six existing labels beside the narrow chart. The X's words use one line to keep the subtitle clear of the coast. The footer CTA uses Paper to keep Red for the prescribed map roles.

The local accessibility and motion-playbook skills were read and applied. The UI skills CLI was not fetched or installed because this task forbids network access and installation. The design-critique-loop gate is incomplete: its [SKILL.md](C:/Users/Admin/.codex/skills/design-critique-loop/SKILL.md) says, "If two independent reviewers are unavailable, do the useful self-checks but clearly state that this independent-review gate is incomplete". The user and this brief explicitly prohibit agents and place the review elsewhere. No score or independent pass is claimed.

depth.mjs, hero-copy, the other briefs, and the other build reports were not edited. No git or install commands were run. Pages and tests used local files or 127.0.0.1. Browser profiles and captures are confined to the authorized comb-a run folder. The protected depth source digest still passes.

## Changed tests and why

- check.mjs: recognizes the additional timeline keys and pending Home/End target; recognizes screen-sized marker text. Its source and packed gzip limits are unchanged.
- steps-test.mjs: the X group now includes Toronto rather than the former narrow centered text-only group; Dig now starts a fade before hidden. Existing continuity gates remain.
- motion-test.mjs: backward repeated Back presses are hurries, with the existing hurry limits; mid-hurry reversals retain their independent minimum-duration checks.
- nova-test.mjs: the native hit is retained for live reduced-motion switching. The trail-run and sea-placement assertions were not loosened.
- whirl2-test.mjs: the late-supply predicate uses actual hand-over progress after the authorized timing overlap. The original blast/remnant digest is unchanged.
- depth-test.mjs: checks the same hero identities at P=72, the actual start of the new overlap, rather than P=100. depth.mjs itself is untouched.
- finds-test.mjs: re-records trip/data digests and the fill metadata digest for non-scaling coast ticks. Sea, coast and depth guards remain. Marker wrapper checks, sheet-arrival/exit waits, deferred completion, and fake-DOM compatibility follow the new behaviour. Object focus assertions avoid printing an enormous circular DOM on failure.
- frame-render-test.mjs: all 21 command snapshots were refreshed for the authorized X framing/hand-over. This is a command recording, not a pixel comparison; WHIRL2 independently keeps the original blast/remnant hash.
- origin-check.mjs: measures the drawn .stone rather than the expanded hit box, and adds 844x390.
- explore-test.mjs: fake-DOM support for the shared exit wrapper; behavioural gates remain.
- frame-cost.mjs: only its allowed output root changes from glide to comb-a.
- audit-capture.mjs: profiles go under its specified capture output folder; arbitrary WxH sizes are supported; background networking is disabled.
- Added comb-browser.mjs and the comb-a-browser, comb-behaviour, comb-extra, comb-reduced, comb-joined-reduced, comb-reopen, comb-close and comb-cost tests for local CDP measurements, capture, focus, live preferences, close timing and the required native tools.

comb-report-test also validates the item count, ASCII content, digest pins and captured comparison data.

Digest pins (normalized FNV-1a): trip.mjs: 3091424451; data.mjs: 3694562013; depth.mjs: 4010889213; fill tick metadata: 12999 / 2682309966.

The complete retained outputs, including failed and superseded runs, follow this handoff. Two early ad hoc diagnostic invocations piped output through Select-Object; their full output was not retained. Their visible errors were the sprite hand-over timing assertion, the supply timing assertion, and fake-DOM API gaps. Later full reruns are retained. One circular-assertion run was stopped after excessive CPU/memory use; the assertion was made concise and the subsequent finds suite passed. No old failed run was deleted.

# COMB-A build record

Scope: COMB-A.md, polish round 2 part 4. No agents, git, installs or external network. Only the allowed source, tools, packed outputs and this report are writable. Browser profiles and captures are under journey-map-runs/comb-a.

Acceptance criteria carried from the approved map and briefs: retain the two-island chart, detailed terrain and creatures, branded shield/card pairs, thin Paper line work, Outfit hierarchy and continuous journey score. Names must remain legible and separate at all eight sizes. Open objects must reverse to their anchors; sheets own input; invisible objects cannot receive focus. Control bands and real text boxes must drive layout. Preserve depth.mjs, WHIRL2, the nova trail run and sea placement. Compare fresh rendered output with the original sheet and before captures.

Independent review is incomplete by instruction: the user and COMB-A forbid reviewer agents. Local self-checks do not substitute for that gate.

RTK was requested by RTK.md but is not installed/on PATH. Four attempted prefixed reads failed with CommandNotFoundException. Continued with existing shell/Node, without installation.

Historical work record. See the final handoff above for current status.
